title: Lumen Lab — Optics Puzzle Studio
description: Bend, split, filter and disperse laser light with mirrors and prisms across 8 verified puzzles, a sandbox and a level editor.
concept: A grid-based optical bench where beams are traced through mirrors, half-silvered splitters, colour filters and dispersing prisms, with additive RGB colour mixing at every target. Puzzle mode ships 8 hand-designed levels — each one machine-verified solvable with its stored solution — plus a piece budget, progress saving and a Solve button. Sandbox mode gives unlimited optics on a 15x10 bench that autosaves, and the Editor lets you build a level, budget the player's pieces and share it as a URL.
features: 3 modes: puzzle campaign, free sandbox, level editor
6 optical components — laser, mirror, beam splitter, colour filter, dispersing prism, blocker
Additive RGB beam mixing with exact-colour targets
8 puzzles verified solvable by simulation, with per-level piece budgets and a Solve hint
Level editor with player-inventory budgeting and shareable base64 URL links
PNG export of the lit board, localStorage progress + sandbox autosave, synthesized audio feedback
tech: Breadth-first beam tracer with (cell, direction, colour) state memoisation
Additive compositing beam glow with animated line dashes

interaction.mouse: Hover the board and pick optics from the palette on the right.
interaction.click: Click an empty cell to place the selected piece; click a placed piece to flip or cycle it; the Erase tool removes it.
interaction.touch: Tap to place, tap again to rotate — the whole board is touch-driven and the panel collapses under the canvas on phones.
interaction.keyboard: Keys 1-8 select a tool, R resets the current board.
